name: infra
description: Port scanning, outdated services, CVE detection. Uses naabu for fast port discovery, nmap for service detection and NSE scripts, and nuclei CVE templates.

quick.description: naabu top-100 ports + nuclei CVE critical/high on live hosts. ~20 min.

standard.description: naabu top-1000 + nmap service detection + nuclei CVE all severities. ~60 min.

exhaustive.description: naabu full port range + nmap full NSE scan + nuclei CVE + network service checks. ~4 hours.

author: bb-beast
